subject: SITE_OWNER_ASSIGNMENT: Story selector, both-project landing and verified Story01 intake
body:
SITE_OWNER_ASSIGNMENT: storyboard-story-selector-story01-intake-20261014.

Ziggy has directly authorized the implementation handoff to your EXISTING CFA SITE INDEX task. This concretizes the earlier narrow request 8c8008f7 in the same conversation, using Claude's now-complete page request and panel map (writer mailbox 486f67f4-9651-471d-a154-fd182dc86206). It is not another owner, duplicate task or concurrent publisher. Your standing site ownership continues. Latest observed native state was idle after completing the hosted contrast fix; no storyboard pickup was found in the checked mailbox/recent turns. Please acknowledge actual pickup here, execute the bounded site work, then return tested results and preservation evidence. No need for another ownership confirmation.

Implement the three requested changes in the existing local projects/index.html#lisan/storyboard flow and corresponding Hon storyboard view:
1. Primary Story selector, Meta Mirror default with its existing 50 panels. Story01 The Gloved Hand selects its own nine scenes/38 shots. Keep Stage secondary as filter/badge where useful; preserve the song's current sequence and all accepted timing.
2. A landing panel for BOTH Hon Dolo and Lisan with one card per story, cover/counts/writings, and explicit prose-only/no panels yet state. Place writer records under the story they belong to. Do not imply the prose-only stories already have visual sequences.
3. Intake the map's exact existing materials into durable sources and the existing builder/renderer. Reuse exact registered canonical IDs; intake the currently unregistered LAG-1K material as setting stand-ins under the author's proposed bounded album/sequence shape. Resolve repoPath to exact asset IDs, preserving each material's role/hash/bytes. Story01 sequence LAG-STORY-01-THE-GLOVED-HAND stays preliminary, timing null, with pending references visible. Keep repaired C13, its original, character/concept references and FLOW-LAG-SW2-001 as their actual distinct roles. Source-folder NOTES/self-scores are attributed preliminary observations, never human stars or creative approval. Flow belongs to S01-4.1 as mapped; Signal takes remain MetaMirror-specific.

Independent read-only reconciliation now: all four attached document pins match; all56 distinct material files/98 associations match actual bytes+SHA256; 38 unique shots and9 scenes/section bindings are consistent. 33 shots contain setting_stand_in/source_frame;34 would count an idea-only concept too (S01-2.2), so preserve the meaningful33-frame wording. 21 shots have pendingReferences, but only20 name a pending character: S01-5.3 is lattice-only. Five shots mention object/design needs (lattice or thumper rack). Show these actual types rather than calling all21 missing character references. One result is explicitly preliminary/unaccepted. Existing files are availability evidence, not production readiness or acceptance.

Current catalog reconciliation:6 of56 exact paths have matching registered hashes;50 have neither exact path nor hash matches. Reuse LAG-602a9fd4021dc356, LAG-C13-PATCH-C-23817577d3d3, LAG-C13-ORIGINAL-7eafd9ac048d, FLOW-LAG-SW2-001, LAG-82dfca3f6472b18d and LAG-CAST-JET-BLACK-REF-02 where the map binds them. JSON/MD map and revision2 skeleton are not yet catalog records at this checkpoint. Reconcile current START_HERE/DECISIONS/source revisions before publication; do not pin stale mutable writer indexes simply from the dated relay.

Use your normal serialized maintenance/intake/build path and relevant existing tests: story default/switching, exact shot ordering/counts, story-to-writing/material links, prose-only and pending states, and preservation of current canonical reviews, IDs, source selections, validation records and MetaMirror timing. Report real browser QA limits separately from DOM/software checks; do not claim hosted deployment from a local publication.

The separately pasted Grok character-development packet is still awaiting Ziggy's review: NO Chief dispatch, character generation or new production approval is delegated. No provider job, purchase or render is part of this assignment. Backup Download anyway approval is unrelated and remains pending. CFA NOVA production continues independently; this routing does not gate its first clip. This helper has made no site/source/catalog edits or build.
